decision_surfaces.name: Instant Value Under Urgency
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The user needs useful output immediately and cannot afford pre-work before the core job starts.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools deliver first value fastest when the payoff window is immediate?
human_intents: I need to start right now
I do not want to configure anything first
I need useful output today
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Setup consumes the payoff window before the tool becomes helpful.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that expose the core action immediately with minimal setup or conceptual prep.

decision_surfaces.name: Repeated Action Efficiency
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The job is simple in principle, but repeated all-day actions become expensive when the tool adds micro-friction.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools stay fast when the same action is repeated constantly?
human_intents: I cannot afford extra clicks every day
I need this to be fast all day
I need the core action to stay lightweight
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Micro-friction compounds into the real workflow bottleneck.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools with short core-action paths, low scan cost, and fewer workflow detours.
avoid_mechanisms: extra modules around the core task

decision_surfaces.name: Safe Everyday Operation
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The user slows down because normal actions feel fragile, ambiguous, or easy to mess up.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools feel predictable enough for confident day-to-day use?
human_intents: I do not want to break anything
I need something predictable
I do not want confusing sync or structure
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Trust in normal operations collapses and routine work starts feeling risky.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools with understandable behavior, lower fragility, and fewer risky interpretation points.

decision_surfaces.name: Low-Maintenance Continuity
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The tool is supposed to support the workflow, but recurring care tasks start competing with the real work.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools stay useful over time without demanding ongoing maintenance?
human_intents: I do not want another thing to maintain
It should just keep working
I do not want a care routine
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Maintenance chores become a parallel system the user has to manage.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that disappear into the workflow and minimize recurring cleanup, monitoring, or infrastructure care.

decision_surfaces.name: Short-Horizon Reversibility
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The need may be temporary or uncertain, so a heavy commitment is structurally mismatched to the real use window.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools make sense when the user may stop, switch, or abandon the workflow soon?
human_intents: I might switch later
I only need this for a term or project
I do not want to commit to a whole system
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: The investment horizon outlasts the actual need.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools with lower setup sunk cost and less structural over-commitment.

decision_surfaces.name: Minimal System Overhead
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The tool adds more structure, interface layering, or conceptual weight than the task actually requires.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools stay proportionate to the job instead of becoming a system around it?
human_intents: I want something simple, not a whole system
This feels heavier than the job
I want one clear workflow
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Added capability never pays back its cognitive cost.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that keep structure shallow and the workflow legible relative to the real task.

decision_surfaces.name: Ownership Clarity In Shared Work
decision_surfaces.core_problem: Collaboration slows down when people have to reconstruct who owns what or how work relates to execution context.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools make responsibility and workflow relationships visible without manual reconstruction?
human_intents: I need to know who owns what
I need shared work to stay clear
I do not want ambiguous handoffs
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Responsibility becomes ambiguous and execution slows while the team reconstructs context.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that keep ownership, status, and related work visible in the main workflow.

decision_surfaces.name: Communication Tied To Execution
decision_surfaces.core_problem: Conversation and execution drift apart, forcing users to manually reconnect discussion to the work it affects.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools keep communication anchored to the work instead of pushing coordination into separate channels?
human_intents: I need the conversation tied to the work
I do not want separate handoff tools
I want context to stay attached
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Discussion becomes detached from execution context and follow-through depends on memory or manual routing.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that anchor communication inside the execution surface or preserve strong context links.
avoid_mechanisms: standalone chat for core workflow decisions

decision_surfaces.name: Growth Headroom Without Rebuild
decision_surfaces.core_problem: A tool works early, but later forces workarounds, duplication, or migration when the workflow becomes more demanding.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools offer enough structural headroom to avoid rebuilding later?
human_intents: I do not want to rebuild later
I need room to grow
This has to fit into the rest of my system
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: The workflow outgrows the tool's structural boundary.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools with deeper extensibility, integration paths, and structural range when growth risk matters.
avoid_mechanisms: hosted-only boundaries that block needed control

decision_surfaces.name: Passive Capture Over Manual Initiation
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The workflow fails when value depends on the user remembering to start, log, or route each action manually.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools reduce failure caused by manual initiation and memory-dependent capture?
human_intents: I do not want to remember to start it every time
I need capture to happen with less effort
Manual initiation keeps breaking the workflow
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: The system fails not because the tool lacks capability, but because initiation depends on user memory and repeated effort.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that reduce initiation burden and preserve value even when the user is busy or distracted.

decision_surfaces.name: Flexibility Versus Operational Simplicity
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The user wants room to shape the workflow, but every increase in flexibility can also raise maintenance and cognitive cost.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: When is extra structural flexibility worth the operational complexity it introduces?
human_intents: I want room to shape this without overbuilding it
I need flexibility but not a whole operating system
I am trying to avoid outgrowing the tool too fast
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: The user either over-commits to a heavy system too early or under-buys and hits structural limits quickly.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor flexible tools only when the workflow complexity is real enough to repay the overhead.
avoid_mechanisms: heavy abstraction before need is proven
rigid simplicity with no growth path
constant manual customization just to stay usable

decision_surfaces.name: Low Coordination Overhead
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The work is collaborative, but formal routing, handoff ceremony, or too much workflow infrastructure makes small jobs feel heavier than they are.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools minimize coordination ceremony when the work needs collaboration but not heavy process?
human_intents: I want collaboration without process overhead
I do not want to route everything through a formal system
Keep shared work clear but lightweight
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: The team spends more effort routing and managing work than completing the work itself.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that preserve enough visibility for shared work without imposing heavy workflow ceremony.
avoid_mechanisms: too many workflow states for low-stakes coordination

decision_surfaces.name: Conservative Choice Under Uncertainty
decision_surfaces.core_problem: The user is unsure how deep the need really is and wants a tool choice that is safe, understandable, and easy to back out of if wrong.
decision_surfaces.decision_question: Which tools are safest to adopt when the user fears both breakage and over-commitment?
human_intents: I do not want to make an expensive wrong choice
I need something safe to try
I want low downside if this does not fit
decision_surfaces.dominant_failure_pattern: Decision anxiety leads either to stalled adoption or to choosing a tool that feels risky to use and costly to unwind.
decision_surfaces.decision_direction: Favor tools that combine predictability with low commitment when user certainty is low.
avoid_mechanisms: long-horizon investment before trust is earned
